title: Execute London Sweep BTC WFA on real data
objective: Execute the London Sweep strategy WFA on BTC 1h data and produce out-of-sample metrics. Previous attempt (EXP-20260317211232-01) was inconclusive due to simulate mode - this run uses LIVE mode with actual WFA engine.
hypothesis: London Sweep fade strategy can capture mean-reversion opportunities on BTC during the London session overlap, with Sharpe > 0 as evidence of directional edge.
inputs: walk forward engine/strategies/london_sweep_btc/wfa_config.yaml (existing config, needs data path fix)
implementation_steps: 1. Copy workspace/data/binance_btcusdt_1h_1000.csv to walk forward engine/data/btcusdt_1h_1000.csv (WFA expects data in engine subfolder)
2. Verify wfa_config.yaml data source path points to 'data/btcusdt_1h_1000.csv'
4. Update backlog to mark IDEA-CRYPTO-002 as in_progress
5. Human executes: cd 'walk forward engine' && .venv\Scripts\python scripts/walk_forward_smoke_test.py --config strategies/london_sweep_btc/wfa_config.yaml
6. Parse WFA output for Sharpe, win rate, max drawdown, trade count
7. Record results to factory/runs/ and factory/leaderboard.json

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA must complete without crash; at least 5 trades in OOS window; Sharpe >= 0

fallback_if_blocked: If WFA crashes on BTC data → check CSV format compatibility, try demo_ohlcv.csv first
If pip-based params fail on BTC price scale → adapt sweep_pips from 3-20 pips to BTC-appropriate thresholds (e.g., 50-500 USDT points)
If no trades generate → widen min_range_pips, disable ATR filter
notes: Previous EXP-20260317211232-01 was inconclusive (score 25) - ran in simulate mode, no real WFA execution
This is the same backlog item (IDEA-CRYPTO-002) being re-attempted with proper LIVE mode execution
Data path mismatch is the most likely blocker - WFA expects data/btcusdt_1h_1000.csv inside walk forward engine/

BTC price scale (~75,000 USDT) means pip-based params (pip=0.0001) produce negligible thresholds - sweep_pips values of 5-20 pips = 0.5-2.0 USDT which is too small. Need to scale params for crypto: sweep_pips should be in USDT points (e.g., 50, 100, 200, 500)
